description: A fourth-floor flat dressed for viewing. Books chosen for their spines, three apples in a bowl on a rota, a wardrobe with four shirts, a bed made tight enough to crease. A diffuser on the hall table. Nobody cooks here.

window.description: The outside of the drum at fourth-floor height, looking south over Kerbstone Row and the Curtain beyond it. The blind is always at exactly the same height, and there is a pencil mark on the frame where the blind is meant to stop.
window.name: the curved glazing

name: New to Market — The Show Home
